pos.personaBrief: Carille's Corinthians conceded the ball, played compact and sought goals via fast counter-attacks (bolanarede 2017-06-17); a 2019 column notes the team often dropped points when it had more possession.

pro.personaBrief: Direct crosses to Jô as reference, quick counters and a safety-first defence, with a base of reliable passers in midfield (Gabriel, Maycon) and Carille admitting passing errors were an issue.

est.personaBrief: A well-drilled 4-1-4-1/4-2-3-1 with fixed roles, a fixed-in-the-box centre-forward (Jô) and two wide players cutting in; little rondo-style relational play.

lar.personaBrief: Two players dropping down the flanks to feed Jô with crosses (Tribuna PR 2018), but the wide men cut in and the midfield was central-heavy, so wings are a route, not a creed.

blo.personaBrief: Compact block with short gaps between defence and midfield and 'everyone helps marking' (Carille, AP 2017); pressure was selective, e.g. on São Paulo's build-up once, rather than constant high pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Sources do not say zonal or man-marking; the evidence is a compact collective block where everyone helps marking, which leans zonal with mixed set-piece details.

pla.personaBrief: Carille kept one defensive-first model regardless of opponent, would not tailor his lineup to the result (Tribuna PR), and preserved the system while making adaptations (Trivela).

res.personaBrief: Openly prioritised defensive safety over attacking show (dol 2017-06-03); 72 points, best defence with 30 conceded, titles over beauty.

sis.personaBrief: System-first: organised collective, ordinary squad kept largely unchanged, everyone helping to mark, 'ganhamos jogos no detalhe'; Jô was a reference but within a defined role.

jog.personaBrief: Solid, hard-working, strong-marking side with a strong centre-back pair and aerial/cross-based attack; Jadson gave technique but the team was built on intensity and organisation.

bas.personaBrief: Experienced squad (Cássio, Fagner, Jadson, Jô) kept stable; Carille wanted to keep 80% of the squad and Jô helped contain the euphoria of the youngest; signings over academy.

lid.personaBrief: Frank man-manager who extracts the best from players and has leaders like Jô advise the young, but also benched Jô when out of form (Trivela) and applies rules evenly.
